falseBehavior: RECORD + CONTINUE only with selected pooled contract, valid stage risk authorization, valid exact-client proof and fixed endpoint identity. Otherwise fail closed.
queryPreserved: Keep the fixed pg_stat_ssl query. Refine its result to distinguish a returned false from no available backend observation; do not hide false by coalescing unavailable to false.
queryError: An SQL/protocol error still stops and rolls back; do not swallow a failed SQL query and continue an aborted transaction. A successful query with no observation may be recorded unavailable.
captureReceipt: Forward capture receipt schema readonly-baseline-capture/2 adds typed transport evidence and retained backend observation. No raw definition/statements.
nonCaptureSessions: Transport _check supplies proof/backend receipt for preflight/apply/verify/exporter sessions before yielding; no transaction.py edits.
recordRechecks: Repeated fixed observations are bound to the same session; no second connection or fallback.
